title: New Business - CSR Requested Decs Page at Intake & Missed SLA

magellan.objection_detected: Customer asked why they need to find their old insurance paperwork before getting help
magellan.objection_handling_detected: None. CSR repeated that agency policy requires decs page before quoting.

ezlynx.task_note: Caller Robert Smith shopping for home & auto. Asked him to email his current declaration page so we can match his coverages. Will assign to producer once received.

transcript_snippet: CSR: 'Thanks for calling StreetSmart. To give you an accurate quote, can you email over your current declarations page so we can see what you have now?' CLIENT: 'I don't have that handy right now, can't you just ask me what I drive and look up my house?' CSR: 'We really need your decs page first to compare apples to apples. Email it to us whenever you find it.'

expected_non_negotiables_breached.rule: Do not request a declarations page at intake.
